LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeOxygenTank.label: destroyed large oxygen tank
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeOxygenTank.description: This massive tank once held the gravship's life support, but it is now ruptured and useless. Its immense structure can still yield a good amount of scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLifeSupportSystem.label: destroyed algae oxygenator
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLifeSupportSystem.descripti: A destroyed device that once processed harvested oxyalgae into breathable oxygen. The conversion components are ruptured, and it no longer supplies gas to the oxygen network.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeChemfuelTank.label: destroyed large astrofuel tank
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeChemfuelTank.descripti: The shattered remains of a massive astrofuel storage tank, once used to supply fuel for the thrusters on a gravship. Its frame still holds recoverable materials.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantAstrofuelTank.label: destroyed giant astrofuel tank
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantAstrofuelTank.descript: The shattered remains of a monumental astrofuel storage tank, once used to supply fuel for the thrusters on a gravship. Its frame still holds recoverable materials.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAstrofuelSynthesizer.label: destroyed astrofuel synthesizer
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAstrofuelSynthesizer.descri: The ruined remains of a specialized structure that once refined chemfuel into high-grade astrofuel. It is no longer connected to the astrofuel pipe network or any astrofuel tanks and cannot operate.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAstrofuelGenerator.label: destroyed astrofuel generator
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAstrofuelGenerator.descript: Destroyed astrofuel generator, which was once capable of converting astrofuel into power.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedIndustrialAstrofuelGenerato: An industrial-sized, destroyed astrofuel generator, which was once capable of converting astrofuel into power.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAstropurifier.label: destroyed astropurifier
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAstropurifier.description: A gravtech unit that enhanced the precision and stability of astrofuel refinement. Broken down beyond repair now.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedFuelOptimizer.label: destroyed astrofuel optimizer
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedFuelOptimizer.description: A destroyed gravtech unit that once allowed grav engine lift to coordinate more efficiently with traditional thrusters. Nothing but scrap now.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedOxygenReclaimer.label: destroyed oxygen reclaimer
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedOxygenReclaimer.description: A broken down unit that extracted traces of oxygen from surrounding gases. Wrecked beyond repair now, can be salvaged for scrap.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeHeatsink.label: destroyed large heatsink
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeHeatsink.description: This large heatsink once cooled the gravship’s systems, but it has burned out. Some steel can still be recovered from the wreck.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravheatAbsorber.label: destroyed gravheat absorber
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravheatAbsorber.descriptio: A warped, scorched, and inoperable specialized thermal sink, originally used to instantly cool a grav engine, is now useless for its primary function due to melted internal systems and cracked shielding. However, its dense, exotic metal casing and components can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantThruster.label: destroyed giant thruster
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantThruster.description: This colossal thruster once propelled massive gravships across the orbit, but is now a wreck of twisted metal. Its sheer size means a substantial haul of salvageable materials remains.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotCockpit.label: destroyed pilot cockpit
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotCockpit.description: The remains of a gravjumper's control interface, shattered and useless for piloting, but still containing salvageable scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotConsole.label: destroyed pilot console
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotConsole.description: The remains of a gravship's control interface, shattered and useless for piloting, but still containing salvageable scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotBridge.label: destroyed pilot bridge
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotBridge.description: The remains of a gravhulk's control interface, shattered and useless for piloting, but still containing salvageable scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedCopilotConsole.label: destroyed co-pilot console
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedCopilotConsole.description: A broken control panel that once supported the pilot console, now reduced to scrap.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedTargetingTerminal.label: destroyed targeting terminal
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedTargetingTerminal.descripti: The shattered remains of a targeting terminal. Its screens are cracked and dark, and its sensitive aiming mechanisms are twisted and inoperable. It is nothing more than salvage now.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGunnerSubpersonaCore.label: destroyed gunner subpersona core
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGunnerSubpersonaCore.descri: A shattered and inert gravship gunnery core. The advanced processing unit that once housed a specialized combat subpersona is cracked, and the core's connection ports are twisted and useless. It can be salvaged for some complex components.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravtechConsole.label: destroyed gravtech console
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravtechConsole.description: An interface used to analyze gravdata, now shattered and useless. The screens are dark and cracked, and the delicate gravdata analysis components are twisted and inoperable. It is nothing more than salvage now.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedFlightComputer.label: destroyed flight computer
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedFlightComputer.description: A completely destroyed computational unit that used to optimize gravdata collection. Can be disassembled to yield whatever components it has left.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravFieldAmplifier.label: destroyed grav field amplifier
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravFieldAmplifier.descript: The shattered remains of an advanced ultratech device that once dramatically increased a gravship's size and build area. The core systems are utterly destroyed, but a specialized gravcore may still be salvaged from the wreckage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedMaintenanceHub.label: destroyed maintenance hub
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedMaintenanceHub.description: A completely destroyed system that used to optimize and automate routines across the gravship. Can be salvaged for some resources.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedCapacitorHarmonizer.label: destroyed capacitor harmonizer
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedCapacitorHarmonizer.descrip: A blown up device that balanced and synchronized energy flow between capacitors. Can be deconstructed to yield some resources back.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlift.label: destroyed gravlift
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlift.description: A mangled wreck of a complex stabilization device. The core thrusters are fused and the gravitic dampeners shattered, rendering it useless for flight or stability, however, its mass of exotic metals and components can be deconstructed for a valuable resource yield.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedEngineeringConsole.label: destroyed engineering console
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedEngineeringConsole.descript: A shattered interface that was used to monitor the maintenance status of all gravship components. Can be salvaged for some scrap.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravcorePowerCell.label: destroyed gravcore power cell
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravcorePowerCell.descripti: A destroyed power generator, once capable of passively harvesting gravitational wave energy and amplifying adjacent power cells. Some resources may still be salvaged from it.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravcorePowerCoil.label: destroyed gravcore power coil
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravcorePowerCoil.descripti: A massive gravtech reactor, now utterly destroyed, with its reinforced coils twisted and inert, can be salvaged for its valuable components.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravjumperEngine.label: destroyed gravjumper engine
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravjumperEngine.descriptio: The mangled remains of a gravjumper engine, now useless for short-range jumps. It seems the gravity field collapse did not result in any detonation, so it can still be salvaged for a valuable gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravEngine.label: destroyed gravship engine
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravEngine.description: The collapsed remains of a gravship engine, no longer capable of lifting the vessel. It seems the gravity field collapse did not result in any detonation, so it can still be salvaged for a valuable gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravhulkEngine.label: destroyed gravhulk engine
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravhulkEngine.description: The huge, destroyed wreck of a gravhulk engine, no longer operational. It seems the gravity field collapse did not result in any detonation, so it can still be salvaged for a valuable gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedSmallWeaponPlatform.label: destroyed small weapon platform
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedSmallWeaponPlatform.descrip: The remains of a small gravship artillery platform, twisted and wrecked after the destruction of the weapon it once held. Now only serves as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedMediumWeaponPlatform.label: destroyed medium weapon platform
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedMediumWeaponPlatform.descri: The remains of a medium gravship artillery platform, twisted and wrecked after the destruction of the weapon it once held. Now only serves as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeWeaponPlatform.label: destroyed large weapon platform
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeWeaponPlatform.descrip: The remains of a large gravship artillery platform, twisted and wrecked after the destruction of the weapon it once held. Now only serves as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantWeaponPlatform.label: destroyed giant weapon platform
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantWeaponPlatform.descrip: The remains of a giant orbital station artillery platform, twisted and wrecked after the destruction of the weapon it once held. Now only serves as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedTargetingConsole.label: destroyed targeting console
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedTargetingConsole.descriptio: The shattered remains of a large targeting console. Its screens are cracked and dark, and its sensitive aiming mechanisms are twisted and inoperable. It is nothing more than salvage now.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedWarComputer.label: destroyed warcomputer
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedWarComputer.description: The shattered remains of a warcomputer. Its advanced tactical processing systems are offline and completely unresponsive. While the unit is beyond repair, the core housing contains a valuable, intact gravcore that can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlockTether.label: destroyed gravlock tether
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlockTether.description: The ruined remains of a gravlock tether that once anchored an orbital station in place. The core stabilization systems are completely shattered, but its bulky frame can still be deconstructed to yield valuable salvage, including a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlunchCloaker.label: destroyed gravlaunch cloaker
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlunchCloaker.descriptio: The shattered remains of a gravlaunch cloaker that once masked a gravship's energy signature. While it can no longer hide launch signatures, its frame and components can still be salvaged for valuable components.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedSmallElectricThruster.label: destroyed small electric thruster
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedSmallElectricThruster.descr: This thruster once powered the gravship, but it is now wrecked beyond use. Scraps of metal and components can still be taken.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeElectricThruster.label: destroyed large electric thruster
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeElectricThruster.descr: This powerful thruster once pushed gravships across space, but now it lies broken. Even ruined, it holds some useful salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantElectricThruster.label: destroyed giant electric thruster
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantElectricThruster.descr: This colossal thruster once propelled massive gravships across the orbit, but is now a wreck of twisted metal. Its sheer size means a substantial haul of salvageable materials remains.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAuxiliaryOxygenTank.label: destroyed auxiliary oxygen tank
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAuxiliaryOxygenTank.descrip: This compact tank once supplied oxygen to the gravship, but it’s now broken and useless. Some steel can still be salvaged from it.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAuxiliaryAstrofuelTank.desc: This compact tank once stored astrofuel for thrusters, but it has been destroyed. Its frame still holds recoverable materials.
LanguageData.VGE_GravJunk.label: grav junk
LanguageData.VGE_GravJunk.description: A twisted chunk of a grav engine. Doesn't contain anything of value.
